OpenCanvas optional subject selection

Google MediaPipe Magic Touch interactive segmenter v2 model, version 1 (int8).
Copyright Google LLC. Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0.
License text: LICENSE in this directory.
Official model source:
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/interactive_segmenter_v2/magic_touch/int8/1/interactive_segmentation.task
Official guide:
https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/interactive_segmenter
Model card linked by the official guide:
https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/Model%20Card%20MagicTouch.pdf

The unmodified official binary is divided into seven transport parts. Concatenating
the parts in manifest.json order reproduces the exact original bytes. Each part
and the complete model have recorded SHA-256 digests.

Runtime: Google MediaPipe Tasks Vision 1.1.1. Shared with the person cutout feature
in ../cutout; see that directory's LICENSE, NOTICE.txt and manifest.json.

OpenCanvas adapter, manual retouch brush and background composition are original
OpenCanvas code. Model quality is not guaranteed. This is subject segmentation,
not generative image editing. Photos are processed locally in the browser.
